title: Method: set_input_color
description: Sets the LED color of an RGB-capable input in the active profile and paints it on the device. The pair (device_id, input_id) is the unique key; calling this method again replaces the previous color, and '#000000' turns the LED off. Colors belong to the profile: switching profiles repaints every RGB input with the new profile's colors. The daemon rejects inputs that are unknown or have no RGB LED (Input.rgb is not true).

input_id.description: Logical identifier of the input within the device. Matches Device.inputs[].id.
